title: Assistant Maintenance Manager
description: Assistant Maintenance Manager Azul Beach Resort (KMS Jamaica Limited) Hanover / St. James / Westmoreland Not disclosed Not disclosed Updated 02/11/2026 HR Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save To organize, direct, and control the Maintenance and Engineering Area in order to guarantee the full satisfaction resulting from the facilities and services of the Hotel, creating a positive atmosphere, optimizing Human, Financial, Material Resources and the supplies provided to the department. To act in the stead of the Maintenance Manager in his absence, when the Manager is out of the property, on a day off, on vacation, on a leave of absence. To supervise the appearance of the personnel of the department, their uniform, their ID tag, and their cleanliness. To assign daily activities according to the activities schedule or work schedule. To check that the necessary requisitions for the correct operation of the department are made on time and correctly. To provide support in, and to coordinate the Preventive Maintenance Schedule. To prepare the daily work plan. To supervise the fulfillment of the safety and hygiene norms and standards in the department. To collaborate in the selection, hiring, and promotion of the personnel of the department. To participate in general meetings and department meetings. To organize the schedules and work roster, and to supervise the correct use of Human Resources To provide the necessary information for the preparation of monthly progress reports for CAPEX Projects in his area. To supervise the facilities within the property on a daily basis, at different hours, in order to achieve the correct operation of the hotel. To follow up on the control of energy sources and on the energy sources campaign follow up. To check that the Annual Preventive Maintenance Plan is followed throughout the hotel areas. To prepare an effective control of department requisitions and to inform the Maintenance Manager accordingly. To check the fulfillment of the norms and the legislation of the operation of facilities and equipment, such as CNA, PROFEPA, Civil Protection, Fire Department, the Police Department (STPS.) To supervise the fulfillment of the safety and hygiene norms throughout the hotel, and to participate in the Protection brigades. To check the adequate and timely application of the training processes, as well as the adequate and timely updating of the department’s personnel. To corroborate the adequate and rational use of the tools, operating equipment, equipment manuals, diagrams, preventive maintenance software, and work orders, facilities and installations, by means of the adequate preparation, updating, and disclosure of the department operation manuals, as well as by means of scheduled weekly inspections. To carry out the evaluations of the personnel as assigned by Human Resources. Qualifications: Academic education o Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a similar degree, as a minimum. Master’s Degree is ideal. Ref: Maintenance Manager Apply Now
